newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's January PMI index rises to 46 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's January PMI index rises to 46 pct.

text.p: Hungary's Purchasing Manager Index (PMI) was 46 percent in January, up from 44.7 percent in December, the Hungarian Association of Logistics, Purchasing and Inventory Management (HALPIM) said on Wednesday.
The following is a history of the index over the year on a month-to-month basis:

NOTE: The PMI is calculated using the same methodology as the United States' National Association of Purchasing Management Index. A figure above 50 indicates increasing economic activity, while a number below 50 shows declining economic activity.
The January figure was low due to seasonal factors as January is traditionally one of the worst-performing months in the Hungarian economy, HALPIM said.
The 46 percent figure indicates that growth in the processing industry did not begin in January following the seasonal fall in December, it added.
